title: IFN-γ as a cytokine node
dek: Wikipedia's interferon-gamma page is a molecule: gene, receptor, macrophage activation. MSMD and IGRAs stay on tb-host-ifng.
story: Interferon-γ on Wikipedia is type II interferon: a soluble signal from T and NK cells that tells macrophages to harden up (plus a pile of other immunologic jobs). TB is one famous context.
Simplfy's tb-host-ifng plate is the IL-12 / IFN-γ / STAT1 Mendelian series and the IGRA echo. This card is the molecule those assays detect.
Recombinant IFN-γ as a drug in rare defects is not a national TB programme tool. Do not turn the encyclopedia pharmacology section into a regimen.
deep: IFNG, IFNGR1, IFNGR2, STAT1 are different QIDs/pages. The clinic plate groups them as an axis.
IGRAs measure IFN-γ protein or IFN-γ-secreting cells after RD1 peptides. They do not measure CFU.
Anti-IFN-γ autoantibodies are an acquired phenocopy mentioned so you hand off to the clinic plate.
Th1 is the helper-cell Wikipedia neighbour (wiki-th1-glossary).

visual.caption: Molecule in the middle: IL-12 in, IFN-γ out, macrophage programmes and IGRA readout as side doors.

example.title: IGRA as a cytokine assay
example.setup: Someone asks whether a QFT IU/mL is a bacterial load.

steps.title: Name the molecule
steps.body: The assay reads IFN-γ (or spots of IFN-γ-making cells).

steps.title: Name the stimulus
steps.body: RD1 peptides, not the whole bacillus burden.

steps.title: Open tb-host-ifng if they want MSMD

example.takeaway: IFN-γ is the molecule. IGRA is one way to see it. CFU is neither.

choices: A type II interferon cytokine node that IGRAs read and macrophages hear
A region of difference in BCG
check.answer: A type II interferon cytokine node that IGRAs read and macrophages hear

check.prompt: QFT-Plus 3.2 IU/mL versus 0.8 IU/mL in two contacts implies:
choices: 4× higher CFU in the first person
A larger IFN-γ assay signal, not a milligram of bacilli
That the second person is BCG
check.answer: A larger IFN-γ assay signal, not a milligram of bacilli

check.prompt: On the mechanism map, the IGRA node is labelled 'not CFU' because:
choices: The assay reads the cytokine, not burden
check.answer: The assay reads the cytokine, not burden
